text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending extending the current pay parking area located on the north side of Gerrard Street East, between Sherbourne Street and Seaton Street, further west. The proposed change will generate approximately two additional on-street pay parking spaces on this portion of Gerrard Street East.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking machines on the north side of Gerrard Street East, between a point 79 metres east of Sherbourne Street and a point 55.5 metres west of Ontario Street, in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, from 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., on Saturday and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., on Sunday, for a maximum period of three hours at a rate of $2.00 per hour. 2. Authorized the installation of parking machines on the north side of Gerrard Street East, between a point 55.5 metres east of Sherbourne Street and a point 55.5 metres west of Ontario Street, to operate from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, from 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., on Saturday and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., on Sunday, for a maximum period of three hours at a rate of $2.00 per hour.
